name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which is a digital signal processing adaptive trend line filter. It enters long when the colored JFatl line changes to bullish color and short when it changes to bearish color, with time window filtering to restrict trading to specific sessions and enhanced Plus features for position management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit数字信号自适应趋势线滤波指标进行交易。当JFatl线颜色转为看涨时做多，转为看跌时做空，同时通过时间过滤器限制在特定交易时段内交易，Plus版本增强了仓位管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于JFatl数字自适应趋势线滤波器，该滤波器结合了Jurik平滑算法和自适应趋势跟踪技术来过滤市场噪音并识别趋势方向。入场条件为当ColorJFatl_Digit指标的颜色发生改变时开仓——颜色从红色变为绿色时开多单，从绿色变为红色时开空单。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓、止损止盈触发平仓以及尾部跟踪止损平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，Plus版本可能包含移动止损和盈亏平衡功能来保护利润。时间过滤器限制EA仅在用户指定的交易时段内进行交易，避免在低流动性或高波动性时段开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the JFatl digital adaptive trend line filter, which combines Jurik smoothing algorithms with adaptive trend-following technology to filter market noise and identify trend direction. Entry conditions trigger when the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator changes color — opening a long position when color shifts from red to green, and a short position when it shifts from green to red. Exit conditions include closing on reverse signal, stop loss/take profit hit, and trailing stop activation. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management in the Plus version likely includes trailing stop and breakeven features to protect profits. The time filter restricts trading to user-specified sessions, avoiding low-liquidity or high-volatility periods for entry.

parameters.name: JFatlPeriod
parameters.description: JFatl自适应趋势线的平滑周期

parameters.name: JFatlPhase
parameters.description: JFatl数字滤波器的相位参数(0-100)

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description_en: Minimum step to adjust take-profit in points

parameters.name: BreakLevel
parameters.description: 盈亏平衡触发的盈利点数

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理动态手数
parameters.description_en: Money management switch; dynamically calculates lots based on balance

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage based on account balance

parameters.name: TimeTradeOn
parameters.description: 是否启用交易时间过滤

parameters.name: SoundOn
parameters.description: 交易信号声音提示开关

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 数字信号处理滤波器有效减少市场噪音，产生更清晰的趋势信号
时间过滤器可避免在不利时段交易，降低滑点和假信号风险
Plus版本提供跟踪止损和盈亏平衡功能，有助于保护已获利润
pros_en: Digital signal processing filter effectively reduces market noise and produces clearer trend signals
Time filter avoids trading during unfavorable sessions, reducing slippage and false signal risks
Plus version provides trailing stop and breakeven features that help protect accumulated profits
cons: JFatl指标作为滞后型趋势跟踪器，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
止损和止盈默认值为0，用户若不手动设置则缺乏基本的风险保护
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一指标信号可能不够可靠
cons_en: JFatl indicator as a lagging trend follower tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, lacking basic risk protection if user does not manually configure them
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, single indicator signals may not be reliable enough
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认逻辑，例如在更高周期验证趋势方向后再入场
添加震荡市场检测过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在无明显趋势时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation logic, such as verifying trend direction on a higher timeframe before entry
Add a ranging market detection filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to pause trading when no clear trend exists

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值为0，若用户未设置则交易无基本保护
单指标趋势跟踪在震荡市中可能连续止损
时间过滤器仅按小时分钟设置，未考虑特定新闻事件或假期
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, trades have no basic protection if user does not set them
Single-indicator trend following can result in consecutive stop losses in ranging markets
Time filter only uses hour/minute settings, does not account for specific news events or holidays
